sentences.zh: 当基本估计寿命的准确度可以接受时，它就可以正常工作，就像在大多数连续使用相同资产的情况下一样。

sentences.en: As we shall see shortly, most of a wardrobe is nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 正如我们很快就会看到的，衣柜里的大部分东西都不是这样的。

blocks.html_en: When I started looking into my clothes, I had no idea of what the lifetime of my garments might be. I of course tried to estimate my use for various items but later learned that nearly all of my initial guesstimates back in 2017 were way too high.

sentences.en: When I started looking into my clothes, I had no idea of what the lifetime of my garments might be.
sentences.zh: 当我开始研究我的衣服时，我不知道我的衣服的使用寿命是多少。

sentences.en: I of course tried to estimate my use for various items but later learned that nearly all of my initial guesstimates back in 2017 were way too high.
sentences.zh: 我当然尝试估计我对各种物品的使用情况，但后来了解到，我在 2017 年的最初猜测几乎都太高了。

blocks.html_en: This is where daily use data corrects the distorted picture and lets you explore what the use really looks like, cleared of biases and wishful thinking.

sentences.en: This is where daily use data corrects the distorted picture and lets you explore what the use really looks like, cleared of biases and wishful thinking.
sentences.zh: 这是日常使用数据纠正扭曲图像的地方，让您探索使用的真实情况，清除偏见和一厢情愿的想法。

blocks.html_en: Actual versus imagined use

sentences.en: Actual versus imagined use
sentences.zh: 实际使用与想象使用

blocks.html_en: Let’s start with the simplest thing: use.

sentences.en: Let’s start with the simplest thing: use.
sentences.zh: 让我们从最简单的事情开始：使用。

blocks.html_en: The figure below shows the cumulative number of wears for all my shoes. The items marked green are divested and provide a benchmark to compare the active items against. The shaded green areas show one and two standard deviations from the mean for the divested items.

sentences.en: The figure below shows the cumulative number of wears for all my shoes.
sentences.zh: 下图显示了我所有鞋子的累计磨损次数。

sentences.en: The items marked green are divested and provide a benchmark to compare the active items against.
sentences.zh: 标记为绿色的项目已被剥离，并提供了比较活跃项目的基准。

sentences.en: The shaded green areas show one and two standard deviations from the mean for the divested items.
sentences.zh: 绿色阴影区域显示与剥离项目平均值的一倍和二倍标准差。

blocks.html_en: In the case of shoes, there is quite a large spread in times worn. This is understandable as the shoes are all unique. My black winter shoes (the ones at the far right) really stand out with over 300 wears and still going.

sentences.en: In the case of shoes, there is quite a large spread in times worn.
sentences.zh: 就鞋子而言，穿着次数差异很大。

sentences.en: This is understandable as the shoes are all unique.
sentences.zh: 这是可以理解的，因为鞋子都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: My black winter shoes (the ones at the far right) really stand out with over 300 wears and still going.
sentences.zh: 我的黑色冬鞋（最右边的那双）确实很引人注目，已经穿了 300 多次，而且仍然穿着。

blocks.html_en: Items that are identical or highly similar, such as underwear T-shirts, tend to have a much smaller spread. The animation below shows the historic time progression of wears for all of my underwear shirts. We can see that this use is rather stable and predictable.

sentences.en: Items that are identical or highly similar, such as underwear T-shirts, tend to have a much smaller spread.
sentences.zh: 相同或高度相似的商品（例如内衣 T 恤）的价差往往要小得多。

sentences.en: The animation below shows the historic time progression of wears for all of my underwear shirts.
sentences.zh: 下面的动画显示了我所有内衣衬衫的历史穿着时间进展。

sentences.en: We can see that this use is rather stable and predictable.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到这种使用是相当稳定和可预测的。

blocks.html_en: Based on the divested (green) sample of 41, we now have a picture of the distribution of the number of wears for items in this category. Underwear shirts typically last between 20 and 25 times. That means an active shirt with about 28 wears is likely to be nearing the end of its lifecycle, and that a shirt that starts falling apart after 10 uses is no good.

sentences.en: Based on the divested (green) sample of 41, we now have a picture of the distribution of the number of wears for items in this category.
sentences.zh: 基于 41 个剥离（绿色）样本，我们现在可以了解该类别商品的穿着次数分布情况。

sentences.en: Underwear shirts typically last between 20 and 25 times.
sentences.zh: 内衣衬衫通常可以穿 20 到 25 次。

sentences.en: That means an active shirt with about 28 wears is likely to be nearing the end of its lifecycle, and that a shirt that starts falling apart after 10 uses is no good.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一件穿着大约 28 次的活跃衬衫可能已接近其生命周期的终点，而一件在使用 10 次后开始散架的衬衫就不好了。

blocks.html_en: Now that we know the number of wears for each item, and the typical use performance range for each category, we are finally ready to start exploring cost performance.

sentences.en: Now that we know the number of wears for each item, and the typical use performance range for each category, we are finally ready to start exploring cost performance.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道了每件商品的磨损次数以及每个类别的典型使用性能范围，我们终于准备好开始探索性价比了。

blocks.html_en: Cost per wear standardizes cost performance

sentences.en: Cost per wear standardizes cost performance
sentences.zh: 每次磨损成本使性价比标准化

blocks.html_en: Tracking the use of a garment, or any durable good, enables studying its real cost performance over its lifecycle. In the context of clothes, I use Cost Per Wear (CPW), a “wear” being one day.

sentences.en: Tracking the use of a garment, or any durable good, enables studying its real cost performance over its lifecycle.
sentences.zh: 跟踪服装或任何耐用品的使用情况，可以研究其在其生命周期内的真实性价比。

sentences.en: In the context of clothes, I use Cost Per Wear (CPW), a “wear” being one day.
sentences.zh: 就衣服而言，我使用每次穿着成本（CPW），“穿着”是一天。

blocks.html_en: The impact of purchase price on CPW is linear and easy: an n% decrease in price means an n% decrease in CPW.

sentences.en: The impact of purchase price on CPW is linear and easy: an n% decrease in price means an n% decrease in CPW.
sentences.zh: 购买价格对 CPW 的影响是线性且简单的：价格下降 n% 意味着 CPW 下降 n%。

blocks.html_en: The impact of use is non-linear as CPW follows a rational function curve a/x, which means the amount of additional wear needed to push down an item’s CPW keeps increasing. This is mathematically simple and intuitive, yet a visualisation may help make this dynamic and its implications stand out.

sentences.en: The impact of use is non-linear as CPW follows a rational function curve a/x, which means the amount of additional wear needed to push down an item’s CPW keeps increasing.
sentences.zh: 使用的影响是非线性的，因为 CPW 遵循有理函数曲线 a/x，这意味着降低物品的 CPW 所需的额外磨损量不断增加。

sentences.en: This is mathematically simple and intuitive, yet a visualisation may help make this dynamic and its implications stand out.
sentences.zh: 这在数学上简单且直观，但可视化可能有助于使这种动态及其含义脱颖而出。

blocks.html_en: Below is a plot of CPW by use for all my shoes. The gray dots trace the use of each item. The blue dots are guide trajectories for items with various purchase prices. Again, items marked in green are divested and no longer move.

sentences.en: Below is a plot of CPW by use for all my shoes.
sentences.zh: 下面是我所有鞋子的 CPW 图。

sentences.en: The gray dots trace the use of each item.
sentences.zh: 灰点追踪每件物品的使用情况。

sentences.en: The blue dots are guide trajectories for items with various purchase prices.
sentences.zh: 蓝点是具有不同购买价格的商品的指导轨迹。

sentences.en: Again, items marked in green are divested and no longer move.
sentences.zh: 同样，标记为绿色的项目已被剥离并且不再移动。

blocks.html_en: The goal is to push each item as low down on the chart as possible through continued use. As mentioned, this becomes slower and slower with increased use. Note that the CPW axis scale is logarithmic.

sentences.en: The goal is to push each item as low down on the chart as possible through continued use.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是通过持续使用将每个项目在图表上的位置尽可能降低。

sentences.en: As mentioned, this becomes slower and slower with increased use.
sentences.zh: 如前所述，随着使用量的增加，速度会变得越来越慢。

sentences.en: Note that the CPW axis scale is logarithmic.
sentences.zh: 请注意，CPW 轴刻度是对数的。

blocks.html_en: CPW is the real cost of each of the times the garment has been worn to date. While that is useful in and of itself, perhaps the biggest benefit of CPW is that it makes garments comparable across price tiers. It helps answer the question of whether quality correlates with price.

sentences.en: CPW is the real cost of each of the times the garment has been worn to date.
sentences.zh: CPW 是迄今为止服装每次穿着的实际成本。

sentences.en: While that is useful in and of itself, perhaps the biggest benefit of CPW is that it makes garments comparable across price tiers.
sentences.zh: 虽然这本身很有用，但 CPW 的最大好处也许是它使不同价格层的服装具有可比性。

sentences.en: It helps answer the question of whether quality correlates with price.
sentences.zh: 它有助于回答质量是否与价格相关的问题。

blocks.html_en: The table below shows the performance of all my white sneakers, active and divested. Note that the maximum limit for the light red CPW column is that of the sample of divested items, as that is the meaningful benchmark.

sentences.en: The table below shows the performance of all my white sneakers, active and divested.
sentences.zh: 下表显示了我所有白色运动鞋的性能，包括活动鞋和脱鞋鞋。

sentences.en: Note that the maximum limit for the light red CPW column is that of the sample of divested items, as that is the meaningful benchmark.
sentences.zh: 请注意，浅红色 CPW 列的最大限制是剥离项目样本的最大限制，因为这是有意义的基准。

blocks.html_en: So what does CPW tell us? Here are a few remarks.

sentences.en: So what does CPW tell us?
sentences.zh: 那么 CPW 告诉我们什么呢？

sentences.en: Here are a few remarks.
sentences.zh: 以下是几点说明。

blocks.html_en: The 90 euro Converse sneakers and the 30 euro Mywears have a similar CPW of 0.87 euros and 0.70 €, respectively. Their effective cost is roughly the same, which means that walking around in the cheap Mywears is roughly as expensive as walking around in Converses. In this case, money buys quality, at least when measured by durability. It takes about two pairs of Mywears to match one pair of Converses. From a sustainability perspective, I would imagine one pair to be better than two, even though the items may have differing individual footprints.

sentences.en: The 90 euro Converse sneakers and the 30 euro Mywears have a similar CPW of 0.87 euros and 0.70 €, respectively.
sentences.zh: 90 欧元的 Converse 运动鞋和 30 欧元的 Mywears 的 CPW 相似，分别为 0.87 欧元和 0.70 欧元。

sentences.en: Their effective cost is roughly the same, which means that walking around in the cheap Mywears is roughly as expensive as walking around in Converses.
sentences.zh: 它们的有效成本大致相同，这意味着穿着便宜的 Mywears 走路的费用与穿着 Converses 走路的费用大致相同。

sentences.en: In this case, money buys quality, at least when measured by durability.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，金钱可以买到质量，至少以耐用性来衡量。

sentences.en: It takes about two pairs of Mywears to match one pair of Converses.
sentences.zh: 大约需要两双 Mywear 才能搭配一双 Converse。

sentences.en: From a sustainability perspective, I would imagine one pair to be better than two, even though the items may have differing individual footprints.
sentences.zh: 从可持续发展的角度来看，我认为一对比两件更好，即使这些物品可能有不同的个体足迹。

blocks.html_en: The more expensive sneakers, the 150 euro Diesels, perform remarkably worse than the two aforementioned. Their actual CPW of 1.88 € is more than twice as high. In this case, money does not seem to buy quality, at least not durability. The Diesels did last twice as long as the Mywears, but they were five times more expensive, leaving them at a far lower level of cost performance.

sentences.en: The more expensive sneakers, the 150 euro Diesels, perform remarkably worse than the two aforementioned.
sentences.zh: 更昂贵的运动鞋，即 150 欧元的 Diesels，其性能比上述两款要差得多。

sentences.en: Their actual CPW of 1.88 € is more than twice as high.
sentences.zh: 他们的实际 CPW 为 1.88 欧元，是其两倍多。

sentences.en: In this case, money does not seem to buy quality, at least not durability.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，金钱似乎买不到质量，至少买不到耐用性。

sentences.en: The Diesels did last twice as long as the Mywears, but they were five times more expensive, leaving them at a far lower level of cost performance.
sentences.zh: Diesel 的使用寿命是 Mywear 的两倍，但价格却是 Mywear 的五倍，因此其性价比水平要低得多。

blocks.html_en: The clear leader at the moment are the Hugo Boss sneakers that are still active and may improve further. The Hugo Boss CPW of 0.57 € is 0.30 € lower than that of the Converses at 0.87 €. This might seem like a rather small difference, but it is 34 percent lower. From a cost performance point of view, that is quite a lot.

sentences.en: The clear leader at the moment are the Hugo Boss sneakers that are still active and may improve further.
sentences.zh: 目前明显的领先者是 Hugo Boss 运动鞋，它们仍然很活跃，并且可能会进一步改进。

sentences.en: The Hugo Boss CPW of 0.57 € is 0.30 € lower than that of the Converses at 0.87 €.
sentences.zh: Hugo Boss CPW 为 0.57 欧元，比 Converse 的 0.87 欧元低 0.30 欧元。

sentences.en: This might seem like a rather small difference, but it is 34 percent lower.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个很小的差异，但实际上降低了 34%。

sentences.en: From a cost performance point of view, that is quite a lot.
sentences.zh: 从性价比的角度来看，这是相当多的。

blocks.html_en: Then there are other still active Jim Rickeys and Helly Hansens in their own league. This is understandable as they are still (hopefully) in the early phases of their lifetime.

sentences.en: Then there are other still active Jim Rickeys and Helly Hansens in their own league.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们自己的联盟​​中还有其他仍然活跃的 Jim Rickeys 和 Helly Hansens。

sentences.en: This is understandable as they are still (hopefully) in the early phases of their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 这是可以理解的，因为他们（希望）仍处于生命的早期阶段。

blocks.html_en: So the conclusion seems to be that, disregarding potential brand and style preferences, the Boss sneakers are the best. We have also seen that in some cases, buying cheap is provenly more expensive. This would support the old saying “I cannot afford to buy cheap.”

sentences.en: So the conclusion seems to be that, disregarding potential brand and style preferences, the Boss sneakers are the best.
sentences.zh: 因此，结论似乎是，无论潜在的品牌和风格偏好如何，Boss 运动鞋是最好的。

sentences.en: We have also seen that in some cases, buying cheap is provenly more expensive.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现，在某些情况下，低价购买实际上会更贵。

sentences.en: This would support the old saying “I cannot afford to buy cheap.”
sentences.zh: 这印证了那句老话：“我买不起便宜货”。

blocks.html_en: Now this is, of course, not always the case. Let’s look at such an example next.

sentences.en: Now this is, of course, not always the case.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: Let’s look at such an example next.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们看这样一个例子。

blocks.html_en: Price might buy quality, but it doesn’t always turn into a comparably low CPW. In my wardrobe, this is the case with shirts, which are plotted below. Again, note the logarithmic CPW axis scale.

sentences.en: Price might buy quality, but it doesn’t always turn into a comparably low CPW.
sentences.zh: 价格可能可以买到质量，但它并不总是能带来相对较低的 CPW。

sentences.en: In my wardrobe, this is the case with shirts, which are plotted below.
sentences.zh: 在我的衣柜里，衬衫就是这种情况，如下图所示。

sentences.en: Again, note the logarithmic CPW axis scale.
sentences.zh: 再次注意对数 CPW 轴刻度。

blocks.html_en: My shirts can be divided roughly into two categories: relatively expensive ones (100 euros and up) and less expensive ones (40 euros and below). These tiers show in the graph as the upper group on a gentle slope, and the lower four on steeper slopes.

sentences.en: My shirts can be divided roughly into two categories: relatively expensive ones (100 euros and up) and less expensive ones (40 euros and below).
sentences.zh: 我的衬衫大致可以分为两类：相对昂贵的（100欧元及以上）和较便宜的（40欧元及以下）。

sentences.en: These tiers show in the graph as the upper group on a gentle slope, and the lower four on steeper slopes.
sentences.zh: 这些层在图表中显示为上层组位于缓坡上，下层四层位于较陡坡上。

blocks.html_en: The expensive divested shirts have a mean CPW of 3.44 €. The less expensive shirts (all of which are still active) are at an average CPW of 1.29 € and decreasing. While the less expensive shirts are still active and may still improve, we can confidently say that they perform significantly better from a cost efficiency perspective.

sentences.en: The expensive divested shirts have a mean CPW of 3.44 €.
sentences.zh: 昂贵的脱衣衬衫的平均 CPW 为 3.44 欧元。

sentences.en: The less expensive shirts (all of which are still active) are at an average CPW of 1.29 € and decreasing.
sentences.zh: 较便宜的衬衫（所有这些仍然活跃）的平均 CPW 为 1.29 欧元，并且还在下降。

sentences.en: While the less expensive shirts are still active and may still improve, we can confidently say that they perform significantly better from a cost efficiency perspective.
sentences.zh: 虽然较便宜的衬衫仍然活跃并且可能仍在改进，但我们可以自信地说，从成本效率的角度来看，它们的表现明显更好。

blocks.html_en: This brings up the obvious point that quality is not limited to, and cannot be measured solely by, durability. In my personal view, the expensive shirts are of higher quality in many regards. This means each wear provides a more valuable subjective experience (better materials, style and cut, details, brand, etc.), which may justify the difference in CPW.

sentences.en: This brings up the obvious point that quality is not limited to, and cannot be measured solely by, durability.
sentences.zh: 这提出了一个明显的观点：质量不仅限于耐用性，也不能仅用耐用性来衡量。

sentences.en: In my personal view, the expensive shirts are of higher quality in many regards.
sentences.zh: 在我个人看来，昂贵的衬衫在很多方面质量都更高。

sentences.en: This means each wear provides a more valuable subjective experience (better materials, style and cut, details, brand, etc.), which may justify the difference in CPW.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每次穿着都会提供更有价值的主观体验（更好的材料、款式和剪裁、细节、品牌等），这可能证明 CPW 的差异是合理的。

blocks.html_en: Through past purchase and use data we now have a way to quantify the difference in the perceived value, i.e. how much more I am willing to pay for a premium experience. Based on my behavior, I can only conclude that I am indeed willing to pay two to three times more for it or roughly 2 euros per wear. I now know the monetary cost of my preference for quality, and I am happy to pay it.

sentences.en: Through past purchase and use data we now have a way to quantify the difference in the perceived value, i.e. how much more I am willing to pay for a premium experience.
sentences.zh: 通过过去的购买和使用数据，我们现在有一种方法可以量化感知价值的差异，即我愿意为优质体验支付多少费用。

sentences.en: Based on my behavior, I can only conclude that I am indeed willing to pay two to three times more for it or roughly 2 euros per wear.
sentences.zh: 根据我的行为，我只能得出结论，我确实愿意为此支付两到三倍的费用，或者每次佩戴大约 2 欧元。

sentences.en: I now know the monetary cost of my preference for quality, and I am happy to pay it.
sentences.zh: 我现在知道我对质量的偏爱所付出的金钱成本，并且我很乐意为此付出代价。

blocks.html_en: The example with shirts goes to show that for myself, wardrobe performance is not about driving down absolute cost, but about finding an optimal balance between value and cost.

sentences.en: The example with shirts goes to show that for myself, wardrobe performance is not about driving down absolute cost, but about finding an optimal balance between value and cost.
sentences.zh: 衬衫的例子表明，对我自己来说，衣柜性能并不是为了降低绝对成本，而是为了在价值和成本之间找到最佳平衡。

blocks.html_en: Frequency of use is the underlying driver of performance

sentences.en: Frequency of use is the underlying driver of performance
sentences.zh: 使用频率是性能的根本驱动因素

blocks.html_en: Since use is a fundamental driver of performance, it makes sense to look at what affects it and seek to understand what might limit it.

sentences.en: Since use is a fundamental driver of performance, it makes sense to look at what affects it and seek to understand what might limit it.
sentences.zh: 由于使用是性能的基本驱动因素，因此了解影响它的因素并寻求了解可能限制它的因素是有意义的。

blocks.html_en: The fastest increase in use for an item is for it to be used every day. Anything less than this means a slower accumulation of use, and hence means a slower progress toward a lower CPW. An item’s “use effectiveness” can thus be measured as frequency of use. In this context, I have defined it as average times worn per month, which is intuitive at the single garment level.

sentences.en: The fastest increase in use for an item is for it to be used every day.
sentences.zh: 一件物品的使用量增长最快的就是它每天都被使用。

sentences.en: Anything less than this means a slower accumulation of use, and hence means a slower progress toward a lower CPW.
sentences.zh: 低于此值意味着使用累积速度较慢，因此意味着降低 CPW 的进度较慢。

sentences.en: An item’s “use effectiveness” can thus be measured as frequency of use.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个项目的“使用有效性”可以用使用频率来衡量。

sentences.en: In this context, I have defined it as average times worn per month, which is intuitive at the single garment level.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我将其定义为每月平均穿着次数，这在单件服装层面上是直观的。

blocks.html_en: To continue with the shoes as an example, below is a plot showing cost per wear and frequency of use, as well as the weighted average for each dimension among divested items (green). The weighted averages show the performance at the category level and provide a benchmark against which to compare the active items. This for me is the most useful plot to actively follow.

sentences.en: To continue with the shoes as an example, below is a plot showing cost per wear and frequency of use, as well as the weighted average for each dimension among divested items (green).
sentences.zh: 继续以鞋子为例，下面的图表显示了每次穿着的成本和使用频率，以及剥离项目中每个维度的加权平均值（绿色）。

sentences.en: The weighted averages show the performance at the category level and provide a benchmark against which to compare the active items.
sentences.zh: 加权平均值显示类别级别的表现，并提供比较活动项目的基准。

sentences.en: This for me is the most useful plot to actively follow.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是最值得积极关注的有用情节。

blocks.html_en: With CPW, lower is naturally better. An active item that is still above the dotted CPW average line is underperforming compared to divested items. It would weaken the category performance if divested. An active item below the same line is already performing better than the divested items. It will improve the category performance when eventually divested.

sentences.en: With CPW, lower is naturally better.
sentences.zh: 对于CPW来说，自然是越低越好。

sentences.en: An active item that is still above the dotted CPW average line is underperforming compared to divested items.
sentences.zh: 与剥离的项目相比，仍高于 CPW 平均线的活跃项目表现不佳。

sentences.en: It would weaken the category performance if divested.
sentences.zh: 如果剥离，将会削弱该类别的表现。

sentences.en: An active item below the same line is already performing better than the divested items.
sentences.zh: 同一条线以下的活跃项目的表现已经好于剥离的项目。

sentences.en: It will improve the category performance when eventually divested.
sentences.zh: 最终剥离后，它将提高该类别的业绩。

blocks.html_en: The dimension of average times worn per month shows the frequency of use for each item relative to the others. Higher is better. Items to the right of the dotted average line have been used more frequently than the category average, while items to the left have been used less frequently.

sentences.en: The dimension of average times worn per month shows the frequency of use for each item relative to the others.
sentences.zh: 每月平均穿着次数维度显示了每件商品相对于其他商品的使用频率。

sentences.en: Higher is better.
sentences.zh: 越高越好。

sentences.en: Items to the right of the dotted average line have been used more frequently than the category average, while items to the left have been used less frequently.
sentences.zh: 平均点线右侧的项目使用频率高于类别平均值，而左侧的项目使用频率较低。

blocks.html_en: The dimension in essence shows how “popular” each item is. This is powerful as it shows real preference versus imagined. This plot is where you will identify those really-like-but-never-wear garments in the upper-left corner. It is pretty brutal. You can probably spot the shoes that I might explain to myself as the ones I “have yet not started using”, but which I perhaps never should have purchased in the first place.

sentences.en: The dimension in essence shows how “popular” each item is.
sentences.zh: 该维度本质上显示了每个项目的“受欢迎程度”。

sentences.en: This is powerful as it shows real preference versus imagined.
sentences.zh: 这是很强大的，因为它显示了真实的偏好与想象的偏好。

sentences.en: This plot is where you will identify those really-like-but-never-wear garments in the upper-left corner.
sentences.zh: 在该图中，您将在左上角识别出那些非常相似但从未穿过的服装。

sentences.en: It is pretty brutal.
sentences.zh: 这是相当残酷的。

sentences.en: You can probably spot the shoes that I might explain to myself as the ones I “have yet not started using”, but which I perhaps never should have purchased in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现我可能会向自己解释这些鞋子是我“尚未开始使用”的鞋子，但我也许一开始就不应该购买它们。

blocks.html_en: Items may have good reasons to be relatively low on frequency. They may be specialised for special occasions. In my shoe plot, the Helly Hansen white sneakers are at my summer house, which limits their potential use significantly. More generally, you can really only use winter clothes in the winter season and summer clothes in the summer season. In order to keep things simple and comparable, I have decided not to account for this “availability of potential use” factor.

sentences.en: Items may have good reasons to be relatively low on frequency.
sentences.zh: 项目可能有充分的理由频率相对较低。

sentences.en: They may be specialised for special occasions.
sentences.zh: 它们可能专门用于特殊场合。

sentences.en: In my shoe plot, the Helly Hansen white sneakers are at my summer house, which limits their potential use significantly.
sentences.zh: 在我的鞋区中，Helly Hansen 白色运动鞋位于我的避暑别墅中，这极大地限制了它们的潜在用途。

sentences.en: More generally, you can really only use winter clothes in the winter season and summer clothes in the summer season.
sentences.zh: 更一般地说，您实际上只能在冬季穿冬装，在夏季穿夏装。

sentences.en: In order to keep things simple and comparable, I have decided not to account for this “availability of potential use” factor.
sentences.zh: 为了使事情简单且具有可比性，我决定不考虑“潜在用途的可用性”因素。

blocks.html_en: Let’s quickly look at the frequency of use over time. This animated visualisation may help see the dynamics we have discussed in action all at once. Below is the same plot, but as a time progression.

sentences.en: Let’s quickly look at the frequency of use over time.
sentences.zh: 让我们快速查看一下一段时间内的使用频率。

sentences.en: This animated visualisation may help see the dynamics we have discussed in action all at once.
sentences.zh: 这种动画可视化可能有助于立即看到我们讨论过的动态。

sentences.en: Below is the same plot, but as a time progression.
sentences.zh: 下面是相同的情节，但按时间顺序进行。

blocks.html_en: The animated plot shows rather brutally which items are rarely used. As time passes, they keep slipping further and further to the left. Here we really see how time keeps eating away at their use frequency, as if they are constantly pushed back by the wind in their fight forward. In a weird way, I feel like I want to cheer them all in their race against time, and each other, to reach the lower-right corner.

sentences.en: The animated plot shows rather brutally which items are rarely used.
sentences.zh: 动画情节相当残酷地展示了哪些物品很少被使用。

sentences.en: As time passes, they keep slipping further and further to the left.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的流逝，它们越来越向左滑动。

sentences.en: Here we really see how time keeps eating away at their use frequency, as if they are constantly pushed back by the wind in their fight forward.
sentences.zh: 在这里我们真正看到了时间是如何不断蚕食他们的使用频率的，就好像他们在前进的过程中不断被风推倒一样。

sentences.en: In a weird way, I feel like I want to cheer them all in their race against time, and each other, to reach the lower-right corner.
sentences.zh: 以一种奇怪的方式，我觉得我想为他们所有人与时间赛跑、为彼此加油、到达右下角而欢呼。

blocks.html_en: Speaking of competition, the point of “competitive dynamics” is also particularly important. The items in a category are generally substitutes (with important aforementioned exceptions). They compete for use in a game where usually only one at a time can take a step forward.

sentences.en: Speaking of competition, the point of “competitive dynamics” is also particularly important.
sentences.zh: 说到竞争，“竞争动态”这一点也尤为重要。

sentences.en: The items in a category are generally substitutes (with important aforementioned exceptions).
sentences.zh: 类别中的项目通常是替代品（上述重要的例外除外）。

sentences.en: They compete for use in a game where usually only one at a time can take a step forward.
sentences.zh: 它们在游戏中竞争，通常一次只有一个人可以向前迈出一步。

blocks.html_en: Since the total potential use of any garment is ultimately limited by the number of days available (there are only so many days in a month), available days become the scarce resource within the category. This is why frequency of use is so helpful in seeking to broaden the understanding of performance.

sentences.en: Since the total potential use of any garment is ultimately limited by the number of days available (there are only so many days in a month), available days become the scarce resource within the category.
sentences.zh: 由于任何服装的总潜在使用量最终都受到可用天数的限制（一个月只有这么多天），因此可用天数成为该类别中的稀缺资源。

sentences.en: This is why frequency of use is so helpful in seeking to broaden the understanding of performance.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么使用频率对于拓宽对性能的理解如此有帮助。

blocks.html_en: We need to make an important distinction between two types of categories: those whose availability for use is heavily affected by the wash cycle, and those for which it isn’t. Shirts, T-shirts, socks, underwear shirts, and boxers I generally wash after each use. That makes them unavailable for use until clean and back in the wardrobe, which might be six days later, or even longer. Let’s call these “restricted”. The “unrestricted” garments then fall into the other categories: jackets, blazers, knits, pants, shorts, belts, and shoes.

sentences.en: We need to make an important distinction between two types of categories: those whose availability for use is heavily affected by the wash cycle, and those for which it isn’t.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对两类类别进行重要区分：一类的可用性受到洗涤周期的严重影响，另一类则不受洗涤周期的影响。

sentences.en: Shirts, T-shirts, socks, underwear shirts, and boxers I generally wash after each use.
sentences.zh: 我通常在每次使用后清洗衬衫、T 恤、袜子、内衣衬衫和平角裤。

sentences.en: That makes them unavailable for use until clean and back in the wardrobe, which might be six days later, or even longer.
sentences.zh: 这使得它们在清洁并放回衣柜之前无法使用，这可能是六天后，甚至更长时间。

sentences.en: Let’s call these “restricted”.
sentences.zh: 我们称这些为“受限”。

sentences.en: The “unrestricted” garments then fall into the other categories: jackets, blazers, knits, pants, shorts, belts, and shoes.
sentences.zh: “不受限制”的服装则分为其他类别：夹克、西装外套、针织衫、裤子、短裤、腰带和鞋子。

blocks.html_en: This obviously has a significant impact on what frequency of use an item can achieve, and what should be considered good performance. But there is a more profound difference in competitive dynamics.

sentences.en: This obviously has a significant impact on what frequency of use an item can achieve, and what should be considered good performance.
sentences.zh: 这显然对一个项目可以达到的使用频率以及什么应该被认为是良好的性能有重大影响。

sentences.en: But there is a more profound difference in competitive dynamics.
sentences.zh: 但竞争动态方面存在更深刻的差异。

blocks.html_en: In unrestricted categories, substitute items compete with each other for use. In these categories, use frequency essentially shows my preference hierarchy between the items, in a way their relative “popularity”. This tends to lead to big differences in performance. And the more substitutes there are, the poorer they all perform.

sentences.en: In unrestricted categories, substitute items compete with each other for use.
sentences.zh: 在不受限制的类别中，替代品相互竞争使用。

sentences.en: In these categories, use frequency essentially shows my preference hierarchy between the items, in a way their relative “popularity”.
sentences.zh: 在这些类别中，使用频率本质上显示了我对项目之间的偏好层次结构，在某种程度上它们的相对“受欢迎程度”。

sentences.en: This tends to lead to big differences in performance.
sentences.zh: 这往往会导致性能上的巨大差异。

sentences.en: And the more substitutes there are, the poorer they all perform.
sentences.zh: 而且替补越多，他们的表现就越差。

blocks.html_en: In restricted categories, substitute items don’t compete with each other, provided that the amount of items only slightly exceeds the maximum amount of items idling in the washing process. As a simplified example you might have seven shirts, one worn every day, and all of which are washed every Sunday. In this case they don’t compete at all. But if you have seven shoes, one pair worn every day, they compete quite fiercely.

sentences.en: In restricted categories, substitute items don’t compete with each other, provided that the amount of items only slightly exceeds the maximum amount of items idling in the washing process.
sentences.zh: 在限制类别中，替代物品不会相互竞争，前提是物品数量仅略高于洗涤过程中闲置物品的最大数量。

sentences.en: As a simplified example you might have seven shirts, one worn every day, and all of which are washed every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 举一个简单的例子，您可能有七件衬衫，一件每天穿，并且所有衬衫每周日都会清洗。

sentences.en: In this case they don’t compete at all.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们根本不竞争。

sentences.en: But if you have seven shoes, one pair worn every day, they compete quite fiercely.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有七双鞋，其中一双是每天穿的，那么它们之间的竞争就相当激烈了。

blocks.html_en: A good example of a restricted category with high substitutability is underwear shirts. I only have two kinds, t-shirts and tanks, and two colors, black and white. So four subcategories within which all items are perfect substitutes. The only way I can tell them apart is by the number I have added to their label. The plot below shows their performance is very similar and easy to predict.

sentences.en: A good example of a restricted category with high substitutability is underwear shirts.
sentences.zh: 具有高可替代性的限制品类的一个很好的例子是内衣衬衫。

sentences.en: I only have two kinds, t-shirts and tanks, and two colors, black and white.
sentences.zh: 我只有两种，T恤和背心，两种颜色，黑色和白色。

sentences.en: So four subcategories within which all items are perfect substitutes.
sentences.zh: 因此，四个子类别中的所有项目都是完美的替代品。

sentences.en: The only way I can tell them apart is by the number I have added to their label.
sentences.zh: 我区分它们的唯一方法是通过我添加到标签上的数字。

sentences.en: The plot below shows their performance is very similar and easy to predict.
sentences.zh: 下图显示它们的性能非常相似且易于预测。

blocks.html_en: This can be contrasted with belts, which is an unrestricted category with medium substitutability (I consider whites, blacks, and browns to be substitutes within their color but not across colors). Here we see widely varying frequency of use and the most “popular” belt clearly stands out at the expense of the others.

sentences.en: This can be contrasted with belts, which is an unrestricted category with medium substitutability (I consider whites, blacks, and browns to be substitutes within their color but not across colors).
sentences.zh: 这可以与腰带形成对比，腰带是一个不受限制的类别，具有中等可替代性（我认为白色、黑色和棕色可以在其颜色内替代，但不能跨颜色替代）。

sentences.en: Here we see widely varying frequency of use and the most “popular” belt clearly stands out at the expense of the others.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们看到使用频率差异很大，最“流行”的腰带显然以牺牲其他腰带为代价而脱颖而出。

blocks.html_en: So competitive dynamics matter. They influence use and therefore cost performance in a rather complex and indirect way. For myself, the key takeaway is to recognize these dynamics and choose an optimization approach accordingly. In short, unrestricted categories should have only a small number of items that you actually use: the “popular” ones. Restricted categories can be more varied, but should only have the amount of items that take you through your wash cycle.

sentences.en: So competitive dynamics matter.
sentences.zh: 因此，竞争动态很重要。

sentences.en: They influence use and therefore cost performance in a rather complex and indirect way.
sentences.zh: 它们以相当复杂和间接的方式影响使用，从而影响成本绩效。

sentences.en: For myself, the key takeaway is to recognize these dynamics and choose an optimization approach accordingly.
sentences.zh: 对我自己来说，关键的一点是认识到这些动态并相应地选择优化方法。

sentences.en: In short, unrestricted categories should have only a small number of items that you actually use: the “popular” ones.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，不受限制的类别应该只包含您实际使用的少量项目：“流行”项目。

sentences.en: Restricted categories can be more varied, but should only have the amount of items that take you through your wash cycle.
sentences.zh: 限制类别可以更加多样化，但应仅包含可引导您完成洗涤周期的物品数量。

blocks.html_en: Someone once said their goal is to have a wardrobe with nothing but favorite clothes. That makes sense not only from a value perspective, but in light of my data, that may also be the best alternative in terms of cost performance.

sentences.en: Someone once said their goal is to have a wardrobe with nothing but favorite clothes.
sentences.zh: 有人曾经说过，他们的目标是拥有一个衣柜，除了最喜欢的衣服之外什么都没有。

sentences.en: That makes sense not only from a value perspective, but in light of my data, that may also be the best alternative in terms of cost performance.
sentences.zh: 这不仅从价值角度来看是有意义的，而且根据我的数据，就性价比而言，这也可能是最佳选择。

blocks.html_en: Category performance shows how well the whole thing works

sentences.en: Category performance shows how well the whole thing works
sentences.zh: 类别表现显示了整个事情的运作情况

blocks.html_en: The category level is about how all items in a category perform as a whole. In addition to average CPW, category cost performance can also be described as category daily cost over time. This has the benefit of showing progress over time.

sentences.en: The category level is about how all items in a category perform as a whole.
sentences.zh: 类别级别是关于类别中的所有项目作为一个整体的表现。

sentences.en: In addition to average CPW, category cost performance can also be described as category daily cost over time.
sentences.zh: 除了平均 CPW 之外，品类性价比还可以描述为品类日成本随时间的变化。

sentences.en: This has the benefit of showing progress over time.
sentences.zh: 这样做的好处是随着时间的推移显示进展。

blocks.html_en: The plot below shows the daily cost of underwear shirts over time. Every dot is one day in time. Green dots are days in which all items are divested at the time of plotting. They no longer change. Red dots are days for which at least one item used that day is still active at the time of plotting, which means that that day’s daily cost may still decrease. Most days, only one item was used. The blue line shows the 30-day rolling average. The yellow shaded areas show summer holidays, which tend to have quite an impact on what I wear – we Finns take our summer holidays very seriously.

sentences.en: The plot below shows the daily cost of underwear shirts over time.
sentences.zh: 下图显示了一段时间内内衣衬衫的每日成本。

sentences.en: Every dot is one day in time.
sentences.zh: 每个点都是时间上的一天。

sentences.en: Green dots are days in which all items are divested at the time of plotting.

sentences.zh: 他们不再改变。

sentences.en: Red dots are days for which at least one item used that day is still active at the time of plotting, which means that that day’s daily cost may still decrease.
sentences.zh: 红点表示在绘图时至少有一项当天使用的项目仍处于活动状态，这意味着当天的每日成本可能仍会下降。

sentences.en: Most days, only one item was used.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，只使用一件物品。

sentences.en: The blue line shows the 30-day rolling average.
sentences.zh: 蓝线显示 30 天滚动平均值。

sentences.en: The yellow shaded areas show summer holidays, which tend to have quite an impact on what I wear – we Finns take our summer holidays very seriously.
sentences.zh: 黄色阴影区域显示暑假，这往往对我的穿着产生很大影响——我们芬兰人非常重视暑假。

blocks.html_en: We can see that the daily cost varies quite a bit depending on the item(s) used. We can also see that many items are in use for quite some time. Some items from 2018 are still in use today (red). This means it takes a rather long time for the average cost trend to show and to settle.

sentences.en: We can see that the daily cost varies quite a bit depending on the item(s) used.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到，根据所使用的物品，每日成本有很大差异。

sentences.en: We can also see that many items are in use for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以看到许多物品已经使用了相当长的时间。

sentences.en: Some items from 2018 are still in use today (red).
sentences.zh: 2018 年的一些物品至今仍在使用（红色）。

sentences.en: This means it takes a rather long time for the average cost trend to show and to settle.
sentences.zh: 这意味着平均成本趋势的显现和稳定需要相当长的时间。

blocks.html_en: Category level daily cost has one very significant benefit. It describes the cost of the “utility” of the particular kind of clothes, regardless of how many or which items were used on how many days. This plot essentially says: “This is how much the use of underwear shirts has been costing you daily”, which is a little over 1 euro per day. This is where improvements in item level performance and the effect of pruning the wardrobe eventually show, although with a significant lag.

sentences.en: Category level daily cost has one very significant benefit.
sentences.zh: 类别级别的每日成本有一个非常显着的好处。

sentences.en: It describes the cost of the “utility” of the particular kind of clothes, regardless of how many or which items were used on how many days.
sentences.zh: 它描述了特定类型衣服的“效用”成本，无论使用了多少天或使用了哪些物品。

sentences.en: This plot essentially says: “This is how much the use of underwear shirts has been costing you daily”, which is a little over 1 euro per day.
sentences.zh: 该图实质上是在表达：“这是您每天使用内衣衬衫所花费的费用”，即每天 1 欧元多一点。

sentences.en: This is where improvements in item level performance and the effect of pruning the wardrobe eventually show, although with a significant lag.
sentences.zh: 这就是物品级别性能的改进和修剪衣柜的效果最终显现出来的地方，尽管有明显的滞后。

blocks.html_en: Portfolio performance is the ultimate measure of progress

sentences.en: Portfolio performance is the ultimate measure of progress
sentences.zh: 投资组合绩效是衡量进展的最终标准

blocks.html_en: We have finally come to the point where we can look at the entire wardrobe. I call this the portfolio level, because it contains my entire portfolio of goods, or assets. It is here that all improvements, big and small, ultimately show.

sentences.en: We have finally come to the point where we can look at the entire wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 我们终于可以看到整个衣柜了。

sentences.en: I call this the portfolio level, because it contains my entire portfolio of goods, or assets.
sentences.zh: 我将其称为投资组合级别，因为它包含我的整个商品或资产组合。

sentences.en: It is here that all improvements, big and small, ultimately show.
sentences.zh: 所有大大小小的改进最终都在这里体现出来。

blocks.html_en: Let’s start by taking a quick look at how the different categories compare. In order for the comparison to be more intuitive, I decided to change the category frequency of use measure from number of wears per month to share of days.

sentences.en: Let’s start by taking a quick look at how the different categories compare.
sentences.zh: 让我们首先快速浏览一下不同类别的比较。

sentences.en: In order for the comparison to be more intuitive, I decided to change the category frequency of use measure from number of wears per month to share of days.
sentences.zh: 为了让比较更直观，我决定将类别使用频率衡量标准从每月佩戴次数更改为天数比例。

blocks.html_en: Now that we have developed a way to describe category performance in a normalized way, we can compare the categories. The plot below shows the average CPW and category frequency of use for all categories.

sentences.en: Now that we have developed a way to describe category performance in a normalized way, we can compare the categories.
sentences.zh: 现在我们已经开发了一种以标准化方式描述类别表现的方法，我们可以比较类别。

sentences.en: The plot below shows the average CPW and category frequency of use for all categories.
sentences.zh: 下图显示了所有类别的平均 CPW 和类别使用频率。

blocks.html_en: At last, we have a complete and exhaustive overview. Even a quick glance reveals which categories are expensive and which are less so, and also which categories are heavily used and which ones only seldom. There seems to be a negative correlation between CPW and frequency or use. It would seem natural – and justified – to accept a higher CPW for clothes that are worn seldom, provided that they last for a long time of course.

sentences.en: At last, we have a complete and exhaustive overview.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们有了一个完整而详尽的概述。

sentences.en: Even a quick glance reveals which categories are expensive and which are less so, and also which categories are heavily used and which ones only seldom.
sentences.zh: 即使快速浏览一下，也可以看出哪些类别价格昂贵，哪些类别价格较低，以及哪些类别使用​​频繁，哪些类别很少使用。

sentences.en: There seems to be a negative correlation between CPW and frequency or use.
sentences.zh: CPW 和频率或使用之间似乎存在负相关关系。

sentences.en: It would seem natural – and justified – to accept a higher CPW for clothes that are worn seldom, provided that they last for a long time of course.

blocks.html_en: Blazers seem very expensive, and they are, if we look at CPW. They cost more than six times more than pants per wear. content_html_zh:
你有没有想过，昂贵的衣服是否物有所值？ 或者在购买昂贵的东西时有一种微妙的内疚感，然后证明它是合理的，因为你会穿着它很多次，即使你不知道它是否是真的？ 如果您认为是，那么这就是为您准备的。

我深入了解我的衣柜，了解我的衣服的真正价格，并在这个过程中学到了很多关于性能、可持续性和我自己的知识。 在这篇博文中，我们将踏上数据支持决策的旅程。 即使数据很小，您也可以获得深刻的见解，并在此过程中获得一些不错的鞋子。

在过去的三年里，我每天连续记录所有衣服的使用情况。

最初是一个简单的问题：买昂贵的衣服是否有意义，现在变成了对衣服性价比的一个相当深刻的发现。 您可以在这里探索我不断更新的衣橱表现。

长期以来，我或多或少的任何消费原则都是买我需要的、用我买的、爱护我拥有的。 然而，对于衣服，我不知道自己到底做得怎么样。

这个项目的见解帮助我改进了我所做的选择。 我最终还构建了一个分析平台，不仅可以用于服装的性能，还可以用于任何耐用品的性能。

这段旅程已经过去了三年，是时候反思我所学到的一切，并希望帮助其他人理解数据支持决策的逻辑、实践和好处。 如果您只是想了解一些整理衣柜的技巧，请阅读本文末尾的实用指南，以清理您的衣柜和消费习惯。

简单的日常佩戴数据

让我们首先简要了解一下数据，因为它是未来一切的核心推动因素。

我的穿着数据是自 2018 年 1 月 1 日以来我每天使用每件衣服的连续日志。 迄今为止，共有 426 个项目、1106 天以及超过 300,000 个使用和未使用的数据点。 所有商品均分为 12 个类别的简单 MECE 结构：夹克和连帽衫、西装外套、针织衫、衬衫、T 恤、裤子、短裤、腰带、袜子、鞋子、内衣衬衫和平角裤。 运动服是“日常”服装之外的一个附加类别。

揭示衣服的真实成本

衣服是耐用品的一种。 因此，仅凭服装的购买价格几乎无法说明其实际性价比。

为了考虑随着使用而恶化的资产的成本，标准方法是在这些资产的预期经济寿命内对其进行折旧。 当基本估计寿命的准确度可以接受时，它就可以正常工作，就像在大多数连续使用相同资产的情况下一样。 正如我们很快就会看到的，衣柜里的大部分东西都不是这样的。

当我开始研究我的衣服时，我不知道我的衣服的使用寿命是多少。 我当然尝试估计我对各种物品的使用情况，但后来了解到，我在 2017 年的最初猜测几乎都太高了。

每次磨损成本使性价比标准化

跟踪服装或任何耐用品的使用情况，可以研究其在其生命周期内的真实性价比。 就衣服而言，我使用每次穿着成本（CPW），“穿着”是一天。

购买价格对 CPW 的影响是线性且简单的：价格下降 n% 意味着 CPW 下降 n%。

使用的影响是非线性的，因为 CPW 遵循有理函数曲线 a/x，这意味着降低物品的 CPW 所需的额外磨损量不断增加。 这在数学上简单且直观，但可视化可能有助于使这种动态及其含义脱颖而出。

CPW 是迄今为止服装每次穿着的实际成本。 虽然这本身很有用，但 CPW 的最大好处也许是它使不同价格层的服装具有可比性。 它有助于回答质量是否与价格相关的问题。

那么 CPW 告诉我们什么呢？ 以下是几点说明。

90 欧元的 Converse 运动鞋和 30 欧元的 Mywears 的 CPW 相似，分别为 0.87 欧元和 0.70 欧元。 它们的有效成本大致相同，这意味着穿着便宜的 Mywears 走路的费用与穿着 Converses 走路的费用大致相同。 在这种情况下，金钱可以买到质量，至少以耐用性来衡量。 大约需要两双 Mywear 才能搭配一双 Converse。 从可持续发展的角度来看，我认为一对比两件更好，即使这些物品可能有不同的个体足迹。

更昂贵的运动鞋，即 150 欧元的 Diesels，其性能比上述两款要差得多。 他们的实际 CPW 为 1.88 欧元，是其两倍多。 在这种情况下，金钱似乎买不到质量，至少买不到耐用性。 Diesel 的使用寿命是 Mywear 的两倍，但价格却是 Mywear 的五倍，因此其性价比水平要低得多。

目前明显的领先者是 Hugo Boss 运动鞋，它们仍然很活跃，并且可能会进一步改进。 Hugo Boss CPW 为 0.57 欧元，比 Converse 的 0.87 欧元低 0.30 欧元。 这似乎是一个很小的差异，但实际上降低了 34%。 从性价比的角度来看，这是相当多的。

使用频率是性能的根本驱动因素

由于使用是性能的基本驱动因素，因此了解影响它的因素并寻求了解可能限制它的因素是有意义的。

一件物品的使用量增长最快的就是它每天都被使用。 低于此值意味着使用累积速度较慢，因此意味着降低 CPW 的进度较慢。 因此，一个项目的“使用有效性”可以用使用频率来衡量。 在这种情况下，我将其定义为每月平均穿着次数，这在单件服装层面上是直观的。

项目可能有充分的理由频率相对较低。 它们可能专门用于特殊场合。 在我的鞋区中，Helly Hansen 白色运动鞋位于我的避暑别墅中，这极大地限制了它们的潜在用途。 更一般地说，您实际上只能在冬季穿冬装，在夏季穿夏装。 为了使事情简单且具有可比性，我决定不考虑“潜在用途的可用性”因素。

动画情节相当残酷地展示了哪些物品很少被使用。 随着时间的流逝，它们越来越向左滑动。 在这里我们真正看到了时间是如何不断蚕食他们的使用频率的，就好像他们在前进的过程中不断被风推倒一样。 以一种奇怪的方式，我觉得我想为他们所有人与时间赛跑、为彼此加油、到达右下角而欢呼。

说到竞争，“竞争动态”这一点也尤为重要。 类别中的项目通常是替代品（上述重要的例外除外）。 它们在游戏中竞争，通常一次只有一个人可以向前迈出一步。

由于任何服装的总潜在使用量最终都受到可用天数的限制（一个月只有这么多天），因此可用天数成为该类别中的稀缺资源。 这就是为什么使用频率对于拓宽对性能的理解如此有帮助。

我们需要对两类类别进行重要区分：一类的可用性受到洗涤周期的严重影响，另一类则不受洗涤周期的影响。 我通常在每次使用后清洗衬衫、T 恤、袜子、内衣衬衫和平角裤。 这使得它们在清洁并放回衣柜之前无法使用，这可能是六天后，甚至更长时间。 我们称这些为“受限”。 “不受限制”的服装则分为其他类别：夹克、西装外套、针织衫、裤子、短裤、腰带和鞋子。

这显然对一个项目可以达到的使用频率以及什么应该被认为是良好的性能有重大影响。 但竞争动态方面存在更深刻的差异。

在不受限制的类别中，替代品相互竞争使用。 在这些类别中，使用频率本质上显示了我对项目之间的偏好层次结构，在某种程度上它们的相对“受欢迎程度”。 这往往会导致性能上的巨大差异。 而且替补越多，他们的表现就越差。

在限制类别中，替代物品不会相互竞争，前提是物品数量仅略高于洗涤过程中闲置物品的最大数量。 举一个简单的例子，您可能有七件衬衫，一件每天穿，并且所有衬衫每周日都会清洗。 在这种情况下，他们根本不竞争。 但如果你有七双鞋，其中一双是每天穿的，那么它们之间的竞争就相当激烈了。

具有高可替代性的限制品类的一个很好的例子是内衣衬衫。 我只有两种，T恤和背心，两种颜色，黑色和白色。 因此，四个子类别中的所有项目都是完美的替代品。 我区分它们的唯一方法是通过我添加到标签上的数字。 下图显示它们的性能非常相似且易于预测。

这可以与腰带形成对比，腰带是一个不受限制的类别，具有中等可替代性（我认为白色、黑色和棕色可以在其颜色内替代，但不能跨颜色替代）。 在这里，我们看到使用频率差异很大，最“流行”的腰带显然以牺牲其他腰带为代价而脱颖而出。

因此，竞争动态很重要。 它们以相当复杂和间接的方式影响使用，从而影响成本绩效。 对我自己来说，关键的一点是认识到这些动态并相应地选择优化方法。 简而言之，不受限制的类别应该只包含您实际使用的少量项目：“流行”项目。 限制类别可以更加多样化，但应仅包含可引导您完成洗涤周期的物品数量。

根据我的背景以及我的一般原则和偏好，以下是一些帮助我整理衣柜的东西。 我绝不声称自己是该主题的任何专家或权威，但如果其中任何内容对任何人有用或启发，我很高兴。 如果没有，我还是很高兴。

找到你需要并且喜欢的东西，然后只买那个。 听起来很容易。 然而建立这门学科是很困难的。 需要和“需要”之间是有区别的，就像商店里的爱和两周后的爱是有区别的。

关注使用，而不是价格。 使用关乎价值。 与任何价值与成本权衡一样，首先寻找价值，然后找出成本可能带来的限制是有意义的。 请记住，更贵的衣服实际上可能更便宜。

避免穿“二线”衣服。 这些是不错的，但似乎永远不会被选入服装，因为你更喜欢非常相似但更好的。 只拥有最喜欢的衣服确实很有意义。

避免穿适合狭窄环境的衣服。 力求让一切尽可能与尽可能广泛的环境兼容。

最大限度地提高跨类别的兼容性。 一种方法是限制你的衣柜调色板。 不兼容的集群会增加库存、减少使用并降低性能。 这也减轻了寻找合适组合的认知负担。

购买长期产品。 一些高质量的服装可能需要穿着多年才能发挥其应有的性能。 为了给它们一个公平的改变，你可能需要做好长期佩戴它们的准备。

好好保养你的衣服。 持续的护理和偶尔的小修理可能会使衣服的使用寿命延长一倍。 将高质量的衣服送到裁缝处进行修理也可能是有意义的。 拉链，那些经常成为衣物杀手的东西，是可以更换的。

知道何时撤资。 尽管我们寻求长期使用，但有一个限度，就不再有理由继续推动。 当你知道卖掉一件你知道效果很好的物品时，享受没有负罪感的感觉。

让你的衣服看起来不错。 在井然有序、光线充足的衣柜里挑选衣服应该像逛商店一样愉快。 好吧，至少这种感觉是可以复制的。 我们倾向于重视那些看起来有价值的东西。

接受你的特殊弱点。 我想我们都有自己的弱点。 我当然知道。 我的一件是西装外套。 尽管进行了所有这些性能优化，我仍然购买了太多。 按照目前的速度，我的供应量可以使用 10 年。 明智的，不。 可爱，是的。 那很好。

下一个：可持续性因素

这就是我迄今为止的衣柜性能之旅的起点。 我觉得扩大而不是深化可能更有意义。 虽然我肯定会每天花这一分钟输入我的佩戴数据，并不断寻求改进我的购买和使用选择，但我接下来可能会追求两个特别感兴趣的领域。

其中之一是可持续性。 货币成本当然不是与衣服相关的唯一成本。 我非常希望以某种方式将可持续发展观点纳入其自身的绩效维度。 对于大多数物品，我收集了它们的重量和材料成分。 让我们看看可以用它做什么。

另一个是扩大所有支出的可比性。 由于使用数据在项目和时间方面都很详尽，因此每个类别和组合都描述了“衣服的效用”。 这使得服装不仅可以与其他类型的随着使用而恶化的有形资产相媲美，而且可以与提供任何类型的连续效用的服务模型相媲美，无论是有形的还是无形的、计量的还是统一费率的。 这反过来又可以评估跨类型支出和跨商业模式的消费替代方案和选择。
